positioning: Plan the trip. Understand the trip. Optimize the trip.

typography.instructions: Use 'font-black' or 'font-light' for radical weight contrast in headings. Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Overlines/Labels MUST be uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]). Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

colors.secondary: Deep Forest Green (Calm, Trust, secondary actions)
colors.rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint neutrals with blue (cool) or orange (warm). Ensure APCA contrast standards. Do not use full-screen gradients. Texture (grain/noise) > gloss.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky headers/floating navs (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70 or bg-black/60, backdrop-saturate-150, 1px inner stroke). Flat solid for data dashboards with 1px border. No muddy transparency. Never use transparent background where content scrolls under.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for luxury feel. Containers with border must have internal padding. Mobile images max-h-[80vh].
visual_enhancers.shadows: Layered ambient + direct shadows. Sharp inner contrasts to ensure accessibility.

grids_and_layouts.marketing: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for landing page. Asymmetry, gap-8 to gap-12, mix 3+ shapes. Never perfectly fill 100%.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B) for Admin Panel and Itinerary Builder. gap-4 to gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
grids_and_layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive (always). Optical alignment over geometrical. Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

motion_and_interactions.rules: Purposeful animation: page transitions, skeleton loaders during live API resolves, animated marker-drop on map load, animated budget counters, hover/press states. MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion.
motion_and_interactions.libraries: framer-motion for layout transitions. react-leaflet for map interactions.

accessibility.rules: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast. aria-hidden on decorative animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

image_urls.description: Hands marking destinations on a world map with travel essentials. Max overlay opacity bg-black/50.
Women hiking with dog, representing outdoor activities and community tab.
Historic buildings in Istanbul, representing city exploration.
Push pins on world map during sunset, useful for empty states or previous trips row.

components_strategy.general: Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogues, inputs. Strip the 'Vercel-look' to match the earthy brand. Don't overuse card component: mix flat, rectangular, and dense styles.
components_strategy.maps: react-leaflet with OpenStreetMap (Nominatim, OSRM, Overpass). Animated marker-drop on map load.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn chart components (recharts) for Budget summary chart and Admin analytics. Must be color-blind-friendly.
components_strategy.forms: Live autocomplete for Starting Point + Destination. Never use native input/select. Use Shadcn components.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, react-leaflet, leaflet, recharts, sonner, @phosphor-icons/react
Implement 12 screens as defined in the requirements, strictly integrating live OpenStreetMap APIs with proper loading/error states.
Trip Score and Budget Guardian features must be highly visual, using earthy accent colors for warnings and scores.
Ensure map overlays and routing lines match the brand colors (e.g., Terracotta for routes).
Customize Shadcn components heavily to fit the organic & earthy aesthetic.
Include 'data-testid' on every button, link, form input, map marker, and interactive chart element.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in '/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx' (adjust path if needed).
